checks.message: Controller identity remains documentation/user-report based; no live controller probing is performed.
Current trigger path is documented as a likely physical route, not live-approved output behavior.
LED gate assignments require external drive/current-limit validation; no LED output is approved by this report.
The report does not enable or approve live hardware outputs.

unknowns.reason: Controller identity is not verified from a live board in this software-only fixture.
Trigger voltage, polarity, load behavior and camera/sync acceptance are not measured by static readiness.
LED drive circuit, current limiting, polarity and load behavior are not inferred from candidate pin names.

blockers.message: Startup readiness must remain blocked until controller identity and safe connection state are verified outside this fixture.
Trigger output behavior is not live-approved; do not command camera or sync trigger output from this report.
LED output behavior is not live-approved; do not drive LEDs from this report.
